name: smwsprites-para-beetle
title: Para-Beetle
description:
This is a flying sprite found in 5-6 in SMB3 as well as a few levels in newer Mario games. Its speed, direction, and size are customizable.
Updates by MarkAlarm: expands the extra byte functionality to allow using all 8 sprite palettes, along with adding a "toxicity" behavior to standing on the para-beetle, which will hurt/kill the player depending on the bits set. Update requested by gohkenytp8. Also includes slightly updated graphics and palette by Anorakun.
